project.name: skychart
project.summary: Cosmic Atlas: Cosmic Atlas is a scientific 2D celestial atlas. It renders Solar System bodies, confirmed exoplanet host systems, Hipparcos bright stars, Gaia physical-map stars, JPL small bodies, DESI DR1 galaxies and quasars, SIMBAD extragalactic objects, BASS DR2 black-hole mass records, nearby stars, Messier deep-sky objects, and the generated OpenNGC NGC/IC deep-sky catalog in one heliocentric ecliptic coordinate space so they can be searched, inspected, centered, measured, and compared.
